ecr.priority: High - 800G DR8 link budget with two patch points
ecr.reason: The 800G DR8 links of Phase 2 pass two patch points; the channel budget needs low-loss connectivity (≤ 0.40 dB per fibre end to end). The switch-side trunk ports change to unpinned adapters, so the trunk MPOs must be pinned. The trunks run through the plenum ceiling and must be OFNP rated. Forecast increased.
ecr.requested_effectivity: All assemblies not yet in production.
ecr.agreed_effectivity: Samples, Lot 1 (Rev A0) and Lots 2 / 3 (Rev B0, material issued) unchanged; Rev C0 / customer Rev C from Lot 4 (PO line 1.5, moved to 2026-12-15 for the 8-week plenum cable and the elite MPO qualification) onwards.

changes.title: Low-loss connectors: MPO-12 APC male elite and LC/APC grade A
changes.from: MPO-12 APC female standard (≤ 0.35 dB), LC/APC grade B (≤ 0.25 dB), end to end ≤ 0.60 dB
changes.to: MPO-12 APC male (pinned) elite (≤ 0.25 dB), LC/APC uniboot grade A (≤ 0.15 dB), end to end ≤ 0.40 dB
changes.reason: 800G DR8 channel budget with two patch points; unpinned switch-side adapters
changes.lpc: Feasible at best capability (LPC-QM-021 §4.3, §4.6). The elite MPO-12 male kit is a new supplier part with first-article qualification (8 weeks). Not requested but required: grade A ferrules are only guaranteed with 100 % end-face geometry measurement (+ 0.5 min per ferrule) and IL test against grade A reference cords.
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 60 per pc full cost (grade A uniboot kits, elite MPO-12 kits, + 21 min 100 % geometry / test)
changes.zone: Sh1 A2, A7, D1, D5, E5 / Sh2 C2, E1, E2 / Sh3 B5

changes.title: Trunk LSZH -> OFNP plenum (UL 1651)
changes.to: UL-listed OFNP plenum trunk cable 36F (3 x 12 ribbon), 4.8 mm
changes.reason: Trunk routed through the plenum ceiling
changes.lpc: Feasible only with UL-listed purchased cable (RM-CB-P36, 8 weeks; LPC-QM-021 §8.2, §9). Not requested but required: the UL listing covers the trunk cable only - the fan-out box and the 3.0 mm legs remain LSZH and must stay inside the rack (non-plenum). Corvane to confirm.
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 21 per pc full cost (UL-listed plenum cable replaces ribbons and jacket)
changes.schedule: Plenum cable 8 weeks - C0 from Lot 4 (2026-12-15)
changes.decision: Accepted - Corvane confirmed legs and fan-out box inside the racks
changes.zone: Sh1 B2, C1, D5 / Sh2 F1
